The round diff shows every other leaf of this record was updated for the fresh attempt (bytes 11358 -> 524, sha256, evidence_path, note, retrieved_at_toronto) while http_status carried over unchanged from the 2026-10-03 record, where 200 was correct for that round's genuine 200 'technical-issues' page. A mechanical status audit therefore reads this failed fetch as successful - a wrong value contradicted by the record's own bound evidence. It is the only attempt-record status mismatch in this candidate (65 fresh records swept; exactly 1 mismatch) and the only one across the prior four rounds (245 records; 0 mismatches).
